section:session-hierarchy-creation.note: <Space>G, <Space>E, <Space>gS, <Space>gT and <Space>B open the one create-entity form with the kind pre-selected

section:session-hierarchy-unified-entity.note: One dialog with the TUI's kind-driven fields: Kind (only kinds some legal parent accepts), Name, Tags (normalize_tag chips, at least one required), Parent (legal containers), Topology for an Epic with the slice-11 DAG preview, and Provider / Model (DiscoverModels suggestions) / Effort / Sandbox plus the prompt for a leaf. Submit is CreateContainer (a Group never passes a topology) or LaunchSession with session_kind, title, parent, tags and a GitWorktree sandbox; the working directory is the filtered project's folder, else the parent's, else the open session's. Esc keeps the draft, Ctrl-D discards it, Ctrl-Enter submits from any field, and the last successful choices prefill the next form. The TUI's single-key field grammar (n, k, T, t, m, e/E, s, gp) is the dialog's own Tab order and controls
